prompts.name: plan_dns_override
prompts.title: Plan a DNS override
prompts.description: Guide an agent through reading state, planning a typed override, and applying only after review. Uses existing tools only.

prompts.name: diagnose_resolution
prompts.title: Diagnose why a name resolved a certain way
prompts.description: Explain a live answer using resolve/explain and the DNS semantics document. Read-only.

prompts.title: Convert runtime drift into a deployment-repository change
prompts.description: Turn in-memory drift into GitOps operations via export. Does not write the bootstrap file.
